name: covia-engine
description: Explain or inspect Brightside's embedded Covia engine: venues, adapters, operations, jobs, agents, request context, identities, capabilities, REST, MCP, A2A and WebDAV.

content.inline:
# Covia engine

Brightside embeds a complete Covia venue in the desktop JVM. Its `Engine` owns the venue identity, lattice application, adapters, operation catalogue, jobs and agents; `VenueServer` exposes the configured protocol surfaces. Brightside's chat uses the same agent operations and records as other authenticated clients rather than a private model shortcut.

Adapters publish live operations under `v/ops`, facts under `v/info/adapters`, and optional skills or templates. Invoking a lifecycle-bearing operation creates a job; an agent is a persistent actor whose sessions and runs live in its lattice record. `RequestContext` carries caller, agent, session, job and capability scope through nested work. Authentication establishes a principal; capabilities independently authorise actions.

For a live explanation, inspect `v/info`, `v/info/adapters` or a specific operation schema. Use the who-am-I tool for the current authenticated principal. Do not infer an enabled adapter or protocol from the architecture alone.
